brief:
The Quincy Institute reported that Israel has launched a coordinated operation to shape conservative American opinion on Middle East policy. The effort involves targeting influential figures, media outlets, and grassroots organizations across the political right through various engagement strategies and messaging campaigns.

The initiative reflects broader Israeli efforts to maintain strong support among U.S. conservative constituencies as domestic political divisions over Middle East policy have widened. The scope and specific methods of the influence operation were not detailed in available reporting.
title: Israel runs covert influence campaign targeting U.S. conservatives
